assembly_state.rationale: The orthosteric site of the reductase is read on the protomer deposited in 1BZL/2JK6/3DJJ; docking runs on the chain that carries the FAD.

cofactor_requirement.rationale: Flavoenzyme: the catalytic site forms on the face of the FAD. Without the cofactor the pocket ceases to exist.

engines._note: Example: no measured affinity is declared for this pair, so the engine's score is not calibrated here. Declare experimental_kd[].state before treating a score as an affinity.
